person_note: The Goodreads material repeatedly presents Yancy, Buck, Coolman, Rick, and other characters externally as he or by name while also entering several characters' perceptions and thoughts, establishing a nonparticipating third-person narrator across widely separated interior scenes. First- and second-person pronouns in the dialogue quotes belong to characters and are local rather than narratorial. The sustained opening excerpt independently uses third-person narration, and two explicit whole-book sources describe the narration as third person moving among multiple character viewpoints. No source found sustained narration in another grammatical person. The main limitation is that the Tier A prose source covers only the opening, but the numerous distributed interior quotes and whole-book descriptions strongly resolve that scope limitation. Quote audit: five locally nondiagnostic action, description, or speech-beat excerpts were conservatively changed to unmarked; stronger sustained passages and web evidence support THIRD.
